definitionZh: 背景大小的 CSS 属性设定元素背景图像的大小. 图像可以留给它的自然大小,拉伸,或者被限制以适应可用的空间.
sourceDefinition: The background-size CSS property sets the size of the element's background image. The image can be left to its natural size, stretched, or constrained to fit the available space.
